name: stripe-payments
description: Stripe Checkout with NestJS and React: signature, duplicate, out-of-order and missed webhooks, each reproduced by a test
author: Nikita MRCS

scripts.dev: concurrently -n contracts,backend,frontend -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @stripe-payments/contracts" "npm run dev -w @stripe-payments/backend" "npm run dev -w @stripe-payments/frontend"
scripts.stripe:secret: docker compose --env-file apps/backend/.env run --rm stripe listen --print-secret
